skill1: Wake Up: Normal attacks deal true damage for 10 sec.

caveats: ⚑ DEF ▼ is modeled as damageTakenPct on the boss (the schema has no boss-DEF-reduction stat). The two DEF ▼ sources (S1 4%×5 = 20%, burst 9.86%) are therefore ADDITIVE in the Damage Up bucket rather than multiplicative on the boss DEF term — this is a magnitude approximation, not a faithful DEF model. If boss DEF enters the formula as a subtractive/divisive term, %-DEF-down is NOT equal to the same % damage-taken-up and this over- or under-credits depending on the ATK/DEF ratio.

⚑ 'Wake Up' is a SELF status but is encoded via the enemy-scoped targetStatus/requiresTargetStatus channel — the only named-status primitive in the schema. It is functionally correct here only because frima is the sole gate-opener and the sole condition is 'is Wake Up live', which is time-identical whether held on self or boss. It is NOT faithful if any engine path scopes the status per-entity.

⚑ Full-charge triggers are encoded as shotFired. frima has chargeFrames 60 and the sim's charge path fires one shot per full charge, so shotFired ≈ per-full-charge — but a NON-full-charge (tapped) shot would also fire it. If the engine can emit uncharged shots for a charge weapon this OVER-fires every S1/S2 block.

⚑ The Sleepy stack ramp is unmodeled: maxStacks 5 applies the full 20% from the first shot rather than accruing over 5 full charges (~5×(0.5s charge + fire) ≈ 4-6s). rampSec is a candidate but the per-stack accrual rate is charge-cadence-dependent and unmeasured.

⚑ The Wake Up entry condition ('6 full charges on a target at MAX Sleepy') is modeled as a bare hitCount:6 — it does NOT verify Sleepy is at 5 stacks first. Real entry is therefore LATER than modeled (Sleepy must reach 5 first, then 6 more charges: ~11 charges, not 6). This makes every Wake-Up-gated true-damage buff go live too early.

⚑ hitCount:6 re-fires every 6 cumulative hits for the whole fight, so Wake Up refreshes perpetually after first entry. Whether the real kit re-arms the same way (or requires re-stacking Sleepy each time) is not stated in the prose.
note: PARSER BASELINE (HYPOTHESIS — NOT a validated model). Every ⚑ below is an UNMEASURED estimate; hand-tune + record against a real fight before trusting any number. frima is a Burst I SR/Iron Supporter charge unit whose whole kit is a two-stage engine: full charges stack Sleepy (boss DEF ▼, 5×4%) and, once max-stacked, 6 more full charges flip her into Wake Up, which unlocks two team-wide True Damage ▲ buffs (28.16%/5s on S2, 49.97%/10s on burst). Her burst adds a 101.66% ATK hit + a second DEF ▼ 9.86%. The team-facing damage contribution is almost entirely the True Damage buffs and the DEF ▼; the Max HP ▲ grants are ally-granted and offensively inert (they do not feed a teammate's atkOfMaxHpPct per the e3 rule) but are kept for kit completeness and for any future consumer. The single SKIPPED line is 'Wake Up: Normal attacks deal true damage' — the schema's only true-normals primitive is weaponSwap.trueNormals, and frima does not swap weapons; encoding a no-op swap purely to set the flag would fabricate a fire cadence, ammo count and charge time she does not have. Her own normal damage stays untyped until the engine gains a standalone true-normals self-flag. Both DEF ▼ lines are modeled as damageTakenPct (see caveats) — a magnitude proxy, not a DEF model.
